# Dr. Alexander Antipov, DDS — Personal Brand & Education Hub
> Last updated: 2026-06-18 — site is EN-only. Russian and Spanish localizations were removed in this delivery.
> Machine-readable JSON feed for agents: https://www.drantipov.com/api/llms (organization, providers, services, locations served, rating, knowledge pages — no pricing)


> Personal website of Dr. Alexander Antipov, DDS, board-certified oral and maxillofacial surgeon based in Roseville, California (since 2008). The site is an educational and personal-brand hub. Surgical and implant services are delivered through two affiliated practices: Galleria Oral & Facial Surgery (oral & maxillofacial surgery, jaw surgery, sleep apnea, facial cosmetic procedures) and Fusion Dental Implants (full-arch and single-tooth dental implant restoration). Dr. Antipov practices alongside Dr. André-David Kahwach, DDS, MD.

## About Dr. Antipov
- Full name: Alexander Antipov, DDS
- Education:
  - Master of Dental Surgery — Moscow State Medical Stomatology University, Russian Federation (1995–2000)
  - Doctor of Dental Surgery (DDS) — Loma Linda University School of Dentistry (2001–2003)
  - Oral & Maxillofacial Surgery — Albert Einstein College of Medicine, Yeshiva University, Department of Dentistry (2007–2008)
- Diplomate, American Board of Oral and Maxillofacial Surgery (ABOMS)
- California Dental License #50724
- DEA Certificate #FA 0689717
- General Anesthesia Permit #GA 1446 (in-office IV sedation)
- Continuing Education Registered Provider #00948675
- Elective Facial Cosmetic Surgery Permit
- CPR / Life Support Network certified
- Practicing in private practice as Oral & Maxillofacial Surgeon since 2008
- Contracted Oral Surgeon, California Department of Corrections and Rehabilitation (Folsom) — 2009–present
- Contracted Oral Surgeon, Sacramento State Prison — 2009–present
- Founder & Director, Smile Again Foundation (2025–present)
- Languages: English

## About Dr. Kahwach
- Full name: André-David Kahwach, DDS, MD
- Education:
  - Doctor of Dental Surgery (DDS) — University of California, San Francisco (graduated with Honors)
  - Doctor of Medicine (MD) — Loma Linda University School of Medicine
  - Oral & Maxillofacial Surgery Residency — Loma Linda University, with advanced training in anesthesia
- Full-scope oral & maxillofacial surgeon — cosmetic procedures, dental implants, facial trauma, orthognathic surgery
- Background in painting and sculpture; precision-and-creativity approach informed by his artistic training
- International medical and dental mission work — Europe, Africa, the Caribbean, the Middle East
- Practices alongside Dr. Antipov at Galleria Oral & Facial Surgery

## Hero Video on Homepage

The homepage features a 25-second looping background video showing the digital full-arch implant workflow performed by Dr. Antipov: 3D CBCT scanning, exocad treatment planning, surgical guide design, and immediate-load placement. Silent, autoplay, looped. Captioned via on-page text. Direct URLs:
- https://www.drantipov.com/videos/hero.mp4 (H.264 MP4, ~5 MB)
- https://www.drantipov.com/videos/hero.webm (VP9 WebM, ~3 MB)
- https://www.drantipov.com/videos/hero-poster.jpg (first-frame poster, 79 KB)

The video demonstrates Dr. Antipov's modern digital workflow with technology partners Zirkonzahn, exocad, and Fusion Dental Academy. The workflow shown is suitable for All-on-4, All-on-6, and zygomatic implant cases performed in a single day.

### English insights articles (medically reviewed by Dr. Antipov)
- [Zygomatic implants — when you need them and how they work](https://www.drantipov.com/for-patients/insights/zygomatic-implants) — Long implants anchored in the cheekbone for severe upper-jaw atrophy. Alternative to staged bone grafting.
- [Same-day dental implants (immediate load) — myth or reality](https://www.drantipov.com/for-patients/insights/same-day-implants) — What you actually get the day of surgery, who qualifies for immediate loading, and the real risks honestly discussed.
- [Dental implants vs dentures — 2026 innovations](https://www.drantipov.com/for-patients/insights/implants-vs-dentures) — Modern implants vs traditional dentures, including 3D printing, nanotechnology, smart implants, AI treatment planning.
- [Dental implant aftercare — recovery tips](https://www.drantipov.com/for-patients/insights/dental-implant-aftercare) — Post-operative care, oral hygiene practices, diet, and recovery timeline.
- [Dental implant complications — understanding risks and management](https://www.drantipov.com/for-patients/insights/dental-implant-complications) — Infection, implant failure, nerve damage, peri-implantitis. Prevention and treatment.
- [The hidden emotional toll of tooth loss](https://www.drantipov.com/for-patients/insights/tooth-lost-emotional-toll) — How tooth loss affects self-esteem and mental health, plus coping strategies and treatment options.
- [Poor oral health and systemic diseases](https://www.drantipov.com/for-patients/insights/poor-oral-health-systemic-diseases) — Connection between oral bacteria and cardiovascular disease, diabetes, cancer.
